why: THE DECK ALREADY HAS TEETH AND THEY ARE NAMED APPROACH OF THE SECOND SUN. Over 120 games against the standard pod it won 0.252 [0.18, 0.34] against a table null of 0.144 — second in the fleet, and above the null with no interval overlap. Twenty of its roughly thirty-eight win-events read 'effect of Approach of the Second Sun' against eighteen by attrition, so the win condition is a seven-mana sorcery cast twice and the deck wins by OUTLIVING the table (mean finishing position 2.32). What kills it is one seat: giada-angels took 39 of its 53 eliminations and won 0.477 of the table. Against that the deck holds TWO sweepers where the audit wants five to seven, and one protection effect where it wants five to seven. Wall of Glare cannot block a flier and Giada's angels all fly. So the hypothesis is not more damage, it is MORE TURNS: cut the package that produced a MEDIAN OF ZERO noncombat damage over 120 games across 116 castings of Iron Maiden, Viseling, Ebony Owl Netsuke and Scrawling Crawler, and buy the turns the second Approach needs. In: Ghostly Prison and Baird (a second and third Propaganda, taxing every attacker), Wrath of God and Cleansing Nova (sweepers three and four, and Forge demonstrably casts the two already here 67 times in 120 games), Settle the Wreckage (a fog and a sweeper at instant speed, which is the flash plan), and Leyline of Anticipation, which the paper list cut and which is the only flash redundancy the deck ever had. THE GOLDFISH CANNOT GRADE THE UPSIDE - it has no opponent that attacks, so a taxer and a sweeper are invisible to it and board power will fall because three creatures leave. FORGE CAN: every one of the six carries no AI:RemoveDeck flag, the sweepers are cast today, and the taxers are static. The pre-registered objective therefore grades the RISK this branch takes rather than the reward it claims: four more white cards, three of them double-white, on a list whose white was only just brought to parity. interaction_6 is the share of games where an answer in hand on turn six could actually be PAID FOR, it is colour-aware, and the champion reads 0.795.
